title: Three Terms and One Short Page
subtitle: 学习与方法 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学习与方法（人与自我·生活与学习·学习与方法）
meta: 主题语境：学习与方法（人与自我·生活与学习·学习与方法）　|　核心词汇：fundamental　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fundamental 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the teacher ① learned a fundamental that no student in the school would have named, and he said the learning was the whole of the term. The ② fundamental, meaning the principle itself and not the rule, ran three terms and stayed unnamed in the book; a fundamental, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ fundamental in that school had the same short page beside it, and the ④ fundamental at the far end, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A fundamental, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to name; the teacher said the naming is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the fundamental was the whole of the matter, meaning the essence and not the principle. The ⑥ fundamental, meaning the essence and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody names; fundamental, he said, is either something you learn or the only word that means both a principle and an essence. He said the essence is the part they remember.

By 1975 the ⑦ fundamental had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short page. The ⑧ fundamental of the whole thing, the teacher wrote in March, was one school and three terms of naming; fundamental, he said, is either the one at the far end or the reason you learned to name. He said the naming was never mentioned.

The ⑨ fundamental I remember is the one named in the plan, which closed in 1977 and is still described as the quietest in the school. A ⑩ fundamental, my mother said in 1979, is the only one that improves by being named; every fundamental, she said, is an essence that has agreed to look like a principle. She said the essence was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 基本原理；根本法则（指学校里每一条旁边的那一条）
B. n. 基本原理（指那一条本身，与具体规则相对）
C. 固定搭配：learn a fundamental 学会一条基本原理
D. n. 基本原理（指留给孩子们的那一条）
E. n. 基本原理（抽象总称，指一所学校的治学之事）
F. n. 基本原理（指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一条）
G. n. 根本；本质（指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）
H. n. 本质（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）

items.q: learned a fundamental that no student in the school would have named
The fundamental, meaning the principle itself and not the rule
the fundamental at the far end

The fundamental of the whole thing

answers.why: learn a fundamental 意为“学会一条基本原理”，1968 年那位先生学会了一条学校里没有一位学生肯说出名字的基本原理。
fundamental 意为“基本原理”，指那一条本身而不是具体规则，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被说出名字。
fundamental 意为“基本原理”，指学校里每一条旁边的那一条，每一条旁边都有同一页短短的讲义。
fundamental 意为“基本原理”，指留给孩子们的那一条，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
fundamental 意为“根本、本质”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西，叔叔说这个根本就是那件事的全部。
fundamental 意为“本质”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西而不是那条基本原理，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
fundamental 意为“基本原理”，指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一条，到 1975 年这一条成了计划里的一行。
fundamental 意为“基本原理”，那位先生三月写道，整件事的治学之事是一所学校和三个学期的说出名字。
fundamental 意为“基本原理”，我记得的是计划里被说出名字的那一条，1977 年结束了，至今仍被说成学校里最安静的一条。
fundamental 为抽象总称，母亲 1979 年说，一条基本原理是唯一会因为被好好说出名字而变得更好的东西。
